'''Ikas-Adno''' was the manufacturer of many [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], and [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]].<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> Originally, it was two separate companies, [[Ikas]] and [[Adno]]. They operated a dozen plants on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kolatill]], within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], where they were supplied with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] parts manufactured by [[GandleMotors]].

During an attempt to outrun several members of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on speeder bikes, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] was pursued by a bike that was manufactured by Ikas-Adno; this particular vehicle, mounting a sidecar, proved difficult to shake off when it became entwined with Horn's bike, connected by a magnetic cable. The sidecar mounting bracket was so strong, it prompted the Rogue to make a mental note to congratulate the manufacturers on their quality&mdash;provided he made it out of that mess alive.<ref name="WG" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
At one point, ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' misspells the company as "'''Ikas-Ando'''."
